governing_proposition: Raw source evidence remains distinct from prepared runtime truth and packet carriage.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed upstream families of admitted raw/source evidence retained with source identity, capture limitations and lineage before runtime preparation. Scope: source-boundary evidence families only.
relationships_and_distinctions: Upstream of Prepared Ingress; may be translated into typed candidates but is not Prepared Ingress, Runtime Context, a cognition stage or packet carriage.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: prepared runtime truth; runtime context; generic payload; cognition decision
input_carrier: validated source-family payloads and capture records
output_carrier: source-family typed candidates and preserved source evidence
decision_owner_vs_context_preparation_ow: source/context owner; not a runtime decision owner
allowed_side_effects: May validate, reject, preserve and translate source evidence at the admitted boundary.
prohibited_authority: No candidate formation, posture/permission, capital deployment, placement, inventory or close authority.
serial_spine_relationship: Supplies evidence to preparation before the six-stage spine; is not part of the spine.
rationale_and_evidence: The domain working overlay expressly separates source truth from prepared truth and carriage; current adapters are implementation evidence only.

governing_proposition: Runtime preparation converts admitted source/reference material into runtime-ready typed inputs without making runtime decisions.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed preparation seam that validates, resolves and maps admitted upstream truth into typed cognition inputs and their lineage. Scope: preparation-to-cognition boundary.
relationships_and_distinctions: Consumes Raw Signal Families; emits Stage Input Bundle/common context; precedes Runtime Context and all six serial stages; cannot reassign source meaning or make stage decisions.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: runtime decision engine; temporal stage; candidate builder; capital gate
ordered_sequence_position: ordered runtime step 1, before calendar projection and serial stage 1
input_carrier: admitted source/reference material, canonical-field receipts and prepared substrate
output_carrier: typed Stage Input Bundle plus immutable common-stage context and lineage references
decision_owner_vs_context_preparation_ow: preparation owner only; never a serial or downstream decision owner
allowed_side_effects: May validate, normalise, resolve admitted source conflicts and emit immutable typed stage inputs with receipts.
prohibited_authority: No temporal/regime/options interpretation, posture permission, playbook eligibility, candidate formation, risk, capital, placement or inventory authority.
serial_spine_relationship: Creates the lawful inputs consumed by the spine; is structurally upstream and outside the six stages.
rationale_and_evidence: The prepared-data normative assigns ingress the bundle and common-context projection while forbidding stage-derived assessments and downstream authority.

governing_proposition: Prepared runtime substrate is a non-owning carrier consumed by bounded runtime owners; a carrier does not acquire semantic decision authority.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed umbrella term for immutable prepared facts, references and bounded runtime substrate available to lawful consumers. Scope: runtime information carriage, not a decision or stage.
semantic_owner: the owners of each contained fact and carrier; no independent Runtime Context decision owner
relationships_and_distinctions: Produced through Prepared Ingress and consumed through typed carriers; broader than any one stage input but must not become an untyped dictionary or hidden authority.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: global mutable context; decision owner; generic metadata bag; stage output
ordered_sequence_position: available after preparation; consumed across ordered runtime steps as lawfully typed
input_carrier: prepared substrate, immutable references and typed context carriers
output_carrier: no autonomous output; facts are re-emitted only by their lawful owners
decision_owner_vs_context_preparation_ow: context carrier only; semantic ownership remains with source, preparation or stage-specific owners
allowed_side_effects: May be read through explicit contracts and preserve immutable identity/lineage.
prohibited_authority: No mutation, policy choice, candidate formation, risk judgement, capital authority or stage substitution.
serial_spine_relationship: Supplies bounded context to stages without joining the six-stage order as an owner.
rationale_and_evidence: The requested boundary is explicit: Runtime Context is substrate/carriage. Treating it as an owner would erase the normative allocation model.

governing_proposition: Temporal Context is the first bounded serial cognition stage and establishes temporal classification/context only.
bounded_definition_and_scope: First serial stage that interprets admitted temporal/calendar facts into bounded temporal phase, event-window and timing context. Scope: temporal interpretation for downstream cognition.
relationships_and_distinctions: Consumes temporal input from Stage Input Bundle/calendar projection; emits TemporalContextOutput; precedes every other serial stage and remains distinct from calendar reference authority.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: calendar authority; regime stage; time of day as complete cognition; capital timing gate
ordered_sequence_position: serial stage 1 of 6; ordered runtime step 3
output_carrier: TemporalContextOutput carried in the stage packet
decision_owner_vs_context_preparation_ow: bounded context-decision owner for temporal classification only
allowed_side_effects: May classify temporal phase/event-window context and emit its immutable output and trace.
prohibited_authority: No regime/options/posture/playbook/expression decision, candidate completion, risk, capital, placement or inventory authority.
serial_spine_relationship: Stage 1 contributes one bounded output to candidate formation; it is not the whole spine.
rationale_and_evidence: The core fixes stage order and the temporal overlay confines this surface to context; current coarse classifiers do not prove completeness.

governing_proposition: Market Regime Context is the second bounded serial stage and owns regime interpretation only.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Second serial stage that interprets admitted market facts into bounded regime context. Scope: market-regime classification and supporting evidence for later stages.
relationships_and_distinctions: Consumes its typed regime input and lawful earlier context; emits MarketRegimeContextOutput; distinct from raw market data, posture permission and capital risk.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: market data feed; posture decision; parallel risk; capital regime override
ordered_sequence_position: serial stage 2 of 6; ordered runtime step 4
output_carrier: MarketRegimeContextOutput carried in the stage packet
decision_owner_vs_context_preparation_ow: bounded context-decision owner for regime interpretation only
allowed_side_effects: May classify regime state and emit bounded evidence/trace.
prohibited_authority: No raw-source ownership, options-flow interpretation, posture permission, playbook choice, capital, placement or inventory authority.
serial_spine_relationship: Stage 2 contributes regime context to later candidate formation; it cannot absorb earlier/later jobs.
rationale_and_evidence: The core fixes it second and forbids stages taking over one another; the current contract is evidence of carrier shape, not completion.

governing_proposition: Options and Flow Context is the third bounded serial stage and owns derived options/flow interpretation only.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Third serial stage that converts admitted options and flow inputs into bounded contextual interpretation for candidate formation. Scope: options/flow context, not source capture or execution.
semantic_owner: Options and Flow Context stage authority
relationships_and_distinctions: Consumes typed options-flow input and lawful prior context; emits OptionsFlowContextOutput; distinct from raw options data, posture, expression and broker execution.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: options feed; order flow execution; posture permission; broker flow
ordered_sequence_position: serial stage 3 of 6; ordered runtime step 5
output_carrier: OptionsFlowContextOutput carried in the stage packet
decision_owner_vs_context_preparation_ow: bounded context-decision owner for options/flow interpretation only
allowed_side_effects: May derive bounded options/flow context and emit immutable evidence/trace.
prohibited_authority: No raw-source ownership, posture permission, playbook eligibility, candidate execution, capital, placement or inventory authority.
serial_spine_relationship: Stage 3 contributes options/flow context to later candidate formation; it remains one stage only.
rationale_and_evidence: The ordered core and typed contract distinguish input carriage from the stage-owned contextual interpretation.

governing_proposition: Posture and Risk Permission is the fourth serial stage and owns bounded candidate-formation posture/permission, not independent risk or capital deployment.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Fourth serial stage that determines the bounded posture and permission state available to later candidate formation. Scope: serial posture/permission only.
semantic_owner: Posture and Risk Permission stage authority
relationships_and_distinctions: Consumes lawful temporal/regime/options context; emits PostureRiskOutput; distinct from the independent Parallel Risk Lane, final risk, capital deployment and position sizing.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: parallel risk; final risk; capital permission; position sizing
ordered_sequence_position: serial stage 4 of 6; ordered runtime step 6
input_carrier: lawful earlier stage outputs and admitted posture policy inputs
decision_owner_vs_context_preparation_ow: bounded serial decision owner for posture and candidate permission only
allowed_side_effects: May emit allow/restrict/stand-down posture state and rationale for later serial stages.
prohibited_authority: No independent environmental-risk packet, final-risk decision, capital sizing/deployment, placement or inventory authority.
serial_spine_relationship: Stage 4 constrains candidate formation; it neither replaces nor consumes the independent lane by implication.
rationale_and_evidence: The normative separation of serial and parallel risk is explicit; the posture label must not smuggle downstream capital authority.

governing_proposition: Playbook Eligibility is the fifth serial stage; it consumes the Playbook Library and owns eligibility, not playbook internals or capital authority.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Fifth serial stage that determines which governed playbook families or setup variants are eligible under the formed context and posture. Scope: eligibility decision only.
relationships_and_distinctions: Consumes posture/context and library metadata; emits PlaybookEligibilityOutput; Playbook Library owns definitions, while this stage owns eligibility.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: playbook library; playbook implementation; strategy selection with hidden capital authority
ordered_sequence_position: serial stage 5 of 6; ordered runtime step 7
input_carrier: lawful earlier outputs plus governed Playbook Library metadata
decision_owner_vs_context_preparation_ow: bounded serial decision owner for playbook eligibility only
allowed_side_effects: May admit, exclude or rank eligible governed playbook variants with rationale.
prohibited_authority: No ownership of playbook internals, fixed playbook count, capital sizing, broker, exit/close, persistence or coefficient authority.
serial_spine_relationship: Stage 5 narrows lawful candidate expressions before stage 6; it is not the library itself.
rationale_and_evidence: The working model explicitly separates the library owner from eligibility and forbids hidden downstream authority.

governing_proposition: Within the serial spine, Expression and Execution forms candidate expression and bounded handoff material; it is not broker execution.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Sixth serial stage that forms the candidate execution expression, lifecycle intent and bounded downstream handoff material. Scope: candidate formation before pre-deployment.
relationships_and_distinctions: Consumes all lawful prior stage outputs and eligibility; emits ExecutionExpressionOutput/StageLocalHandoffSurface; distinct from placement readiness, broker submission, fills and live state.
lawful_aliases: execution-expression stage; expression stage; execution expression
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: broker execution; order placement; fill handling; placement readiness; live inventory
ordered_sequence_position: serial stage 6 of 6; ordered runtime step 8
input_carrier: ExecutionExpressionInput assembled from lawful prior stage outputs
decision_owner_vs_context_preparation_ow: bounded serial decision owner for candidate expression only
allowed_side_effects: May form candidate expression/lifecycle intent and emit immutable bounded handoff material.
prohibited_authority: No broker/API submission, placement readiness, execution receipt, fill authority, inventory mutation, exit or close execution.
serial_spine_relationship: Final stage of the six-stage spine; completes candidate material but does not authorise fresh capital.
rationale_and_evidence: The working overlay defines the name narrowly because ordinary-language “execution” would otherwise imply forbidden downstream behaviour.

governing_proposition: Serial Desk-cognition is lawful shorthand for the governed Serial Desk-cognition Spine and does not establish a second spine, stage, owner or candidate-forming meaning.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Lawful shorthand for the canonical ordered six-stage Serial Desk-cognition Spine. Scope: terminology compatibility only; no independent ontology or authority.
semantic_owner: serial desk-cognition authority through the canonical Serial Desk-cognition Spine
relationships_and_distinctions: Alias of Serial Desk-cognition Spine; not a seventh stage, not Serial Candidate, and not a separate architecture surface.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: separate spine; single monolithic stage; Serial Candidate synonym; orchestrator authority
ordered_sequence_position: alias for ordered runtime steps 3-8 collectively
input_carrier: same as Serial Desk-cognition Spine; alias carries no input contract
output_carrier: same as Serial Desk-cognition Spine; alias carries no output contract
decision_owner_vs_context_preparation_ow: no independent owner; canonical spine and six stage owners retain authority
prohibited_authority: No independent stage, candidate, capital, placement, inventory or parallel-risk authority.
serial_spine_relationship: Exact fixed label is an alias of the canonical Serial Desk-cognition Spine.
rationale_and_evidence: The fixed PM-007 label appears as shorthand in governing serial-output/path propositions, while the normative core names the full architecture Serial Desk-cognition Spine. Explicit alias disposition preserves fixed-label coverage without inventing a second meaning.

governing_proposition: The Serial Candidate is formed material emitted by the six-stage spine and remains distinct from any deploy/stand-down decision.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed carrier for candidate material formed after all six serial stages and before downstream pre-deployment and capital authority. Scope: candidate state and trace only.
semantic_owner: serial desk-cognition authority for formation; downstream consumers are read-only
relationships_and_distinctions: Result of Serial Desk-cognition; input to pre-deployment and capital authority; may be blocked or declined downstream without changing its historical identity.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: capital decision; authorised position; order; live position
ordered_sequence_position: after serial stage 6 and before ordered runtime step 9
input_carrier: six bounded serial stage outputs and lineage
output_carrier: immutable serial candidate material and identity
decision_owner_vs_context_preparation_ow: formed output carrier; not an autonomous decision owner
allowed_side_effects: May preserve candidate expression, eligibility, stage evidence, identity and lineage for downstream evaluation.
prohibited_authority: No fresh-capital authorisation, broker placement, live-position or inventory mutation.
serial_spine_relationship: Is the output of the spine, not the spine itself and not the Capital Deployment Decision.
rationale_and_evidence: The core explicitly separates candidate formation, blocking and fresh-capital judgement; conflating them would erase the fail-closed downstream gates.

governing_proposition: Capital deployment authority acts downstream of formed candidate and pre-deployment truth to decide whether and how bounded fresh capital is deployed.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed downstream decision and receipt meaning for no-trade/reduce/continue/block action, authorised deployable percentage and bounded notional. Scope: fresh-capital deployment authority only.
relationships_and_distinctions: Consumes Serial Candidate, pre-deployment/final-risk/capital-state/policy truth; precedes opening; distinct from candidate formation, placement and live inventory.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: serial candidate; opening authorisation; placement readiness; broker order; position sizing by confidence
ordered_sequence_position: ordered runtime step 10, after pre-deployment and before opening
input_carrier: serial candidate, pre-deployment receipt, final-risk receipt, capital-state snapshot, bounded policy, coefficient/modifier bounds and optional parallel-risk packet
decision_owner_vs_context_preparation_ow: downstream decision owner for bounded fresh-capital deployment
allowed_side_effects: May decide no-trade/reduce/continue/block and emit bounded deployable percentage/notional with input trace.
prohibited_authority: No candidate formation, serial-stage decision, parallel-risk generation, opening mechanics, broker placement or live-inventory mutation.
serial_spine_relationship: Consumes but never rewrites the Serial Candidate; remains downstream of the six-stage spine.
rationale_and_evidence: The core and ownership supplement define a separate fresh-capital judgement; the contract additionally rejects opening/broker authority keys.

governing_proposition: Cognition ingress emits one typed Stage Input Bundle containing common immutable context plus narrowly typed stage carriers; the bundle is carriage, not a stage or owner.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Generic typed preparation-to-serial seam carrier that groups immutable common-stage context and admitted stage-specific input carriers. Scope: cognition-ingress output carriage.
semantic_owner: cognition ingress owns bundle construction; contained facts retain their semantic owners
relationships_and_distinctions: Emitted by Prepared Ingress and consumed by stage owners; related to Runtime Context but narrower and typed; current alpha class carries only temporal/regime/options-flow inputs and does not prove complete six-stage coverage.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: runtime context as exact synonym; stage output; complete serial spine; generic dictionary
input_carrier: immutable common-stage context plus admitted stage-specific typed carriers
output_carrier: one typed bundle or detached dispatch with common-context reference plus exactly one stage carrier
decision_owner_vs_context_preparation_ow: generic carrier construction owner; no stage decision owner
allowed_side_effects: May group, validate and dispatch immutable typed stage inputs and lineage references.
prohibited_authority: No stage-derived assessment, candidate state, risk, capital, placement, execution fact or mutable runtime state.
serial_spine_relationship: Feeds the six-stage spine but is neither a stage-specific family nor an alias for the spine/Runtime Context.
rationale_and_evidence: The normative prepared-data contract is broader than the present three-member alpha class; implementation incompleteness is preserved rather than promoted to semantic law.

governing_proposition: Capital Deployment Authority is the downstream owner that acts only after candidate formation, parallel-risk output and pre-deployment gating, and decides whether and in what bounded way fresh capital may be deployed.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Downstream authority surface that consumes formed candidate material, pre-deployment result, parallel-risk product and capital state, and owns bounded fresh-capital judgement. It is not the judgement record itself.
relationships_and_distinctions: Distinct from Capital Deployment Decision, which is its output; downstream of Serial Desk-cognition Spine, Parallel Risk Lane and pre-deployment gate; upstream of opening architecture.
lawful_aliases: capital deployment; downstream capital deployment authority
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: candidate formation; serial execution stage; parallel risk generation; opening placement mechanics
ordered_sequence_position: Downstream of serial candidate, parallel risk and pre-deployment; upstream of opening architecture.
input_carrier: Serial candidate material; pre-deployment result; parallel risk packet; capital state; bounded deployment policy.
output_carrier: Capital Deployment Decision and capital-deployment receipt.
decision_owner_vs_context_preparation_ow: Owns fresh-capital judgement only; upstream owners retain candidate, environment and preparation meaning.
allowed_side_effects: May issue bounded deploy/stand-down authority and authorised notional/percentage through governed output.
prohibited_authority: Must not form the candidate, regenerate parallel risk, own opening mechanics or reinterpret upstream stage semantics.
serial_spine_relationship: Consumes serial candidate material downstream; never becomes a serial stage.
stage_input_bundle_classification: Not a Stage Input Bundle owner or member.
rationale_and_evidence: The normative core repeatedly names and bounds the authority itself. The existing Capital Deployment Decision record covers only its output, so treating “capital deployment” as a noncanonical form of the decision collapsed owner and product.

governing_proposition: The Serial Desk-cognition Spine is the canonical ordered collective structure of six bounded stages and owns candidate-formation order and outputs only.
bounded_definition_and_scope: Governed structural term for the mandatory ordered six-stage candidate-formation spine. Scope: stage ordering, lawful dependencies and collective candidate formation.
relationships_and_distinctions: Comprises six distinct stage owners; consumes prepared inputs and forms Serial Candidate; distinct from Parallel Risk Lane, pre-deployment and capital authority.
disallowed_or_misleading_phrases: single monolithic stage; orchestrator authority; end-to-end trading workflow
input_carrier: typed prepared/stage inputs and lawful earlier-stage outputs
output_carrier: six bounded stage outputs forming Serial Candidate material
decision_owner_vs_context_preparation_ow: structural/order owner; stage-specific semantic decisions remain with each stage owner
allowed_side_effects: May enforce order, dependencies, trace propagation and candidate-formation handoff.
prohibited_authority: No capital allocation, order placement, position sizing, live inventory or Parallel Risk Lane authority.
serial_spine_relationship: Is the structural spine itself, not a seventh stage and not an alias for Serial Candidate.
rationale_and_evidence: The exact Spine label is a top-level governing heading and repeated proposition across the normative core. It is the canonical structural term; Serial Desk-cognition is retained separately as a lawful shorthand alias, not silently substituted for this label.
